about: The postcommunio of the formulary “18th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Strengthened by Your sacred gift, we thank You, O Lord, beseeching Your mercy to make us receive it worthily. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
